reviews.text:
First visit in March and the last.
The vet was nice to our cat, and that's where it ended. I left with medication (€120) for a 10-day course of treatment that was completely useless (second opinion from another vet). What's worse is that she prescribed three Credelio tablets to be given every 15 days to treat ear parasites, which the cat didn't have. This medication is given to treat fleas once a month. Disappointed by this visit, I should have been more wary and paid attention to the reviews.

I am very disappointed and hurt by the reception I received at this veterinary clinic. I arrived five minutes late for my first appointment and immediately apologized sincerely, but I felt judged from the start.

During the consultation, the vet told me my cat was "too small" to be neutered and that it was risky. However, after getting a second opinion from another vet, I was told it was simply his normal weight and that there was no particular problem.

What struck me most was the complete lack of communication. I asked questions about my cat and received almost no answers. At one point, she looked at my cat's tongue and said, "What's that?" I asked her if it was serious and received no response. When you pay nearly €300 for spaying and microchipping, you expect at least a little explanation and support.

The worst part was the appointment to have the stitches removed. We had agreed on 9:30 a.m. over the phone. I arrived at 9:17 a.m. to make sure I wasn't late. She gave me a dirty look, didn't even say hello, and accused me of being late, saying I was "always late," before slamming the door in my face.

I felt humiliated and judged, especially because I'm young and it was my first time at the vet. It was a very sad experience for me, because you go there primarily for your pet's well-being and you hope to be treated with a minimum of respect and kindness.

I'm posting this review now, with a clear head after I've recovered.

At first, I really liked this vet. I was a loyal client of her practice, but I had a traumatic experience and I can't say I would recommend her after this. My young cat was sick, and she offered me an appointment. I arrived early. In the waiting room, my cat started coughing up blood and died... I was devastated, sitting in the waiting room chair, witnessing this disaster. Losing my friend, Roland, like that... The vet arrived and was immediately cold, asking me to bring the carrier into the office. A little kindness would have been appreciated, perhaps helping me calm down at that moment, being gentle, and carrying the carrier myself. Then she told me she couldn't take the body. Almost the first thing you tell me. A little tact would have been appreciated. Then she told me to make my decision immediately and take the body to another clinic. I told her I couldn't. She said, "I'm not the one who's going to do it." (I never asked you to do it.) And carrying my dead cat for 15-20 minutes while I was in a daze wouldn't have been possible for me. My mother came to get me. She found me struggling to think, completely disoriented. You didn't examine my cat to try to understand what happened to him. Keep in mind that I loved Roland more than anything, and that providing support is part of your responsibility. It's a shame. Especially since Roland was your patient.

My daughter, whose cat was a regular patient at this clinic and therefore well-known, lost her cat in the waiting room this past Saturday.
The vet showed absolutely no empathy and didn't take the time to support Marine through this very painful loss. She even made inappropriate and harsh remarks without offering any support whatsoever. I picked up my daughter in a state of shock. I think this kind of attitude is outdated, and that most vets make a point of being there for her during these complex times of grief for the animals who are part of our lives.
I had an appointment today for my cat and I highly recommend it!
Best practitioner, top-notch, meow meow, sorry, she's a competent and incredibly kind feline expert.

How can a vet with such a nasty attitude have any clients???

I called to ask for some information, and I wasn't disappointed; I can confirm the negative reviews about her.
She asked me if I was a client, I said no, and it was almost as if I had to pay for an answer. I didn't get any response when I saw her blatant dishonesty.

And what about professional ethics?
Given her hours, she's a mercenary vet who has no empathy for cats, but definitely for your money. Run away!

My little Frida wasn't doing well: anxiety, weight loss, refusal to eat... Dr. Arquilliere helped me understand my cat. Today, she's calm and slowly gaining weight.

I would recommend her practice to everyone I know. The doctor spent countless hours explaining everything to me (we talked for a very long time!), and she was incredibly gentle and kind with my cat, who arrived terrified and ended up so reassured she dozed off.

Thank you, Frida!

A passionate and gentle veterinarian. She loves animals, and it shows! In an emergency, she made herself available and took the time to care for my cat, who was sick and refusing to eat. We discovered what was making her ill and found a way to get her eating again, which allowed us to save her life!

A solo vet who treats only cats. Don't listen to the negative reviews; I've only had positive experiences with her. She's a very attentive vet who takes the time to explain everything (we just adopted a kitten).
Passionate about cats and therefore about her work. In addition to their health, she also cares about the well-being of our beloved felines! I highly recommend her!

Avoid this vet unless you enjoy being treated rudely and left standing at the door. We had an appointment for our cat, but the "vet" refused to let us in, claiming we didn't have a carrier that closed. We had brought a litter box, and I clearly explained that my cat was so unwell he wouldn't move. Instead, she told me to go buy a carrier and that she wouldn't treat my cat!

In short, avoid this place at all costs. Her office is filthy and full of cobwebs. I understand the quick appointments!

Beware of this healthcare professional who can't resist sharing the phone number or even the full name of her dissatisfied clients! Thank you, madam, for giving out my number. You had my name, so why publish it on Google? To all potential future clients, feel free to call me to learn more about this firm ;) You can reach me by text or phone.
